fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].PartI[0].c1_3[0]
fields.speak: Regulations section 1.1411-10(g) election (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_3[0]
fields.speak: 1. Taxable interest (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_4[0]
fields.speak: 2. Ordinary dividends (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_5[0]
fields.speak: 3. Annuities (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_6[0]
fields.speak: 4a. Rental real estate, royalties, partnerships, S corporations, trusts, trades or businesses, etc. (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_7[0]
fields.speak: 4b. Adjustment for net income or loss derived in the ordinary course of a non-section 1411 trade or business (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_8[0]
fields.speak: 4c. Combine lines 4a and 4b.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_9[0]
fields.speak: 5a. Net gain or loss from disposition of property (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_10[0]
fields.speak: 5b. Net gain or loss from disposition of property that is not subject to net investment income tax (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_11[0]
fields.speak: 5c. Adjustment from disposition of partnership interest or S corporation stock (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_12[0]
fields.speak: 5d. Combine lines 5a through 5c.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_13[0]
fields.speak: 6. Adjustments to investment income for certain C F Cs and P F I Cs (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_14[0]
fields.speak: 7. Other modifications to investment income (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_15[0]
fields.speak: 8. Total investment income. Combine lines 1, 2, 3, 4c, 5d, 6, and 7.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_16[0]
fields.speak: Part I I. Investment Expenses Allocable to Investment Income and Modifications. 9a. Investment interest expenses (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_17[0]
fields.speak: 9b. State, local, and foreign income tax (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_18[0]
fields.speak: 9c. Miscellaneous investment expenses (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_19[0]
fields.speak: 9d. Add lines 9a, 9b, and 9c.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_20[0]
fields.speak: 10. Additional modifications (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_21[0]
fields.speak: 11. Total deductions and modifications. Add lines 9d and 10.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_22[0]
fields.speak: Part I I I. Tax Computation. 12. Net investment income. Subtract Part I I, line 11, from Part I, line 8. Individuals, complete lines 13–17. Estates and trusts, complete lines 18a–21. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_23[0]
fields.speak: Individuals: 13. Modified adjusted gross income (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_24[0]
fields.speak: 14. Threshold based on filing status (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_25[0]
fields.speak: 15. Subtract line 14 from line 13. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_26[0]
fields.speak: 16. Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 15.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_27[0]
fields.speak: 17. Net investment income tax for individuals. Multiply line 16 by 3.8% (0.038). Enter here and include on your tax return (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_28[0]
fields.speak: Estates and Trusts: 18a. Net investment income (line 12 above).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_29[0]
fields.speak: 18b. Deductions for distributions of net investment income and charitable deductions (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_30[0]
fields.speak: 18c. Undistributed net investment income. Subtract line 18b from line 18a (see instructions). If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_31[0]
fields.speak: 19a. Adjusted gross income (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_32[0]
fields.speak: 19b. Highest tax bracket for estates and trusts for the year (see instructions).

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_33[0]
fields.speak: 19c. Subtract line 19b from line 19a. If zero or less, enter 0.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_34[0]
fields.speak: 20. Enter the smaller of line 18c or line 19c.

fields.name: topmostSubform[0].Page1[0].f1_35[0]
fields.speak: 21. Net investment income tax for estates and trusts. Multiply line 20 by 3.8% (0.038). Enter here and include on your tax return (see instructions).
